evidence_excerpts: 50 qubits is a significant milestone, because that’s beyond what can be simulated by brute force using the most powerful existing digital supercomputers.
Noisy emphasizes that we’ll have imperfect control over those qubits; the noise will place serious limitations on what quantum devices can achieve in the near term.
text: NISQ computers with roughly 50 to a few hundred qubits mark a classically hard simulation regime, but noisy gates place serious near-term limits on what they can compute.
